questions.question_text: How many significant figures are in $0.05070$?

options.why: Counted every digit, including the leading zeros, which are not significant.
Did not count the final zero, which is significant at the end of a decimal.
Counted only the non-zero digits, missing the significant zeros between and after them.

questions.solution_text:
The leading zeros are not significant; the figures $5$, $0$, $7$, $0$ are.
$0.05070$ has $4$ significant figures.

questions.question_text: Treating the final zeros of a whole number as significant, how many significant figures are in $20\,600$?

options.why: Did not count the final zeros, which the whole-number convention treats as significant.
Counted the zero between the digits but missed one of the final zeros.
Counted only the non-zero digits, ignoring every significant zero.

questions.solution_text:
The zero between $2$ and $6$ and the final zeros are all treated as significant.
$20\,600$ has $5$ significant figures.

questions.question_text:
A whole number rounded to one significant figure is $500$.
What is the largest whole number it could be?

options.why: Went one too far — $550$ rounds up to $600$, not down to $500$.
Gave the largest number below $500$ instead of the largest that rounds to $500$.
Stopped at a multiple of ten instead of the largest whole number that still rounds down.

questions.solution_text:
Any number from $450$ to $549$ rounds to $500$.
Largest $=549$
